note: Discrete seats of the turned hat per hull mode. Hull-local hat units: x across (owner braid +X), z along the brim (stern +Z, bow -Z), y up from the water line or the ground; one unit is hullScale/16 blocks; a seat yaw r faces (sin r, -cos r) and adds to the hull entity yaw.

hop_rim.lore: a parabola under Minecraft gravity (delivery.gravity) clearing the brim by delivery.clear, at least delivery.hop_tmin ticks

climb_rim.lore: ruling water 11: bite the brim, hook the braid over it, pull the body up and slide over the rim; braidless kinds use the mouth only

lift.lore: the parent's braid tip curls into a cradle under the body (mouth for braidless kinds); the carried body rides as a hull passenger while it moves
